insights: Moving beyond simple vector search to multi-hop reasoning RAG.
Agents are increasingly being used to pre-process and structure knowledge before retrieval.
Heavy focus on 'GraphRAG' (combining knowledge graphs with RAG) in Chinese communities.
Visual programming for agents is dominating.
Users prefer rigid, deterministic node-based workflows over fully autonomous agents for business tasks.
High demand for integrations with WeChat and Feishu.
Emerging trend of hierarchal memory: short-term (context window), working memory (summarized state), long-term (vector DB).
Discussions on how to make agents 'forget' irrelevant information efficiently.
